description.value: Wasuta Pasta is a Japanese-Italian fusion restaurant situated along the Fraser River waterfront in Richmond, making it a naturally scenic stop for cyclists riding the River Road dyke route. The kitchen produces handmade pasta and desserts daily, blending Italian technique with Japanese flavour profiles. Both dine-in and takeout options are available, and the waterfront setting is marketed as a destination cafe experience.
